title: Lean AI SDLC: deterministic-first routing, consolidated reviewers, enforced guardrails

acceptance_criteria.outcome: Routing assigns tiers by explicit high-risk paths: ordinary product UI/tests/framework docs are standard (no security review); auth, money, migrations, AI, exports, CI/deploy, gates and hooks are high; generated/scratch paths are excluded; replaying Nov-2026 commits yields far fewer high-risk routes (was 33/40).

Reviewers are consolidated to code-reviewer, ui-reviewer, security-reviewer and product-reviewer (request-only), each read-only with a bounded turn budget and preloaded skill; Codex agents are generated from the Claude agents and validated for parity.
verify.sh prints a bounded summary per command (failure excerpt <= 20 lines) and writes full logs to gitignored .sdlc-logs/, keeping going in the fast profile.

Shared PreToolUse guard (Claude + Codex) denies force-push to main/release and forced audit fixes, and asks before push, hook bypass, release tags, mutating gcloud/gh, destructive git and alembic without a localhost DATABASE_URL; heredoc/quoted text is not treated as commands.
Weakened tests (deleted test files, new skip/only/xfail, net assertion loss) fail test_integrity.py in pre-commit and CI unless acknowledged by a human trailer/env.
CI runs secret scanning and dependency audits on every PR/main push, and a path-triggered migration rehearsal applies new revisions on the previous release schema, downgrades and re-applies them.
release_tools.py prepare/verify produce a pre-filled release record from CI, git and read-only GCP data, leaving unprovable manual checks open; release waivers apply only to manual checks.
Root AGENTS.md is <= 9 KiB with area rules moved to nested AGENTS.md files imported by sibling CLAUDE.md files, and no Key Decision is lost.
usage_report.py reports tokens, subagent share and agent/skill counts from local Claude/Codex logs without content; eval scenarios check routing deterministically and can run behaviorally on request.
Standard-risk work may use a light record and scoped evidence; high-risk work keeps the full record and full-snapshot evidence.
